svg.text: SMART AQUA POND — REALISTIC DIGITAL HARDWARE WIRING DIAGRAM
Arduino Uno R4 WiFi · LM2596S 5.0V Buck Converter · 4-Channel Optocoupled Relay Module · 5 Water Sensors · 4 Actuators · ESP32-CAM
830-POINT SOLDERLESS BREADBOARD — REGULATED 5.0V & COMMON GROUND (GND) BUS
Primary Sensor Acquisition & Relay Controller (115200 baud)
Active-LOW Logic (IN1–IN4) · High-Voltage Isolation · Every NC Terminal Left EMPTY
Controlled by Arduino Pin D4 (Relay IN1)
Controlled by Arduino Pin D5 (Relay IN2)
Controlled by Arduino Pin D6 (Relay IN3)
5V Power gated by Pin D10 (Relay K4)
TS-300B Amplifier Module (G · A · D · V)
• Seated directly on ESP32-CAM-MB USB Baseboard
• Streams live MJPEG to Dashboard & Fish-Stress Engine
6. QUICK ARDUINO UNO R4 WiFi PIN CHECKLIST
D0 (RX) & D1 (TX) : LEAVE EMPTY (USB Serial COM5)
D2 : DS18B20 Temp Probe (S / Yellow Data)
D6 : Relay IN3 (Aerator Air Pump — K3)
D7 : Ultrasonic TRIG / TX | D8 : Ultrasonic ECHO / RX
D9 : MG996R Servo PWM (Yel) | D10: Relay IN4 (Servo 5V Gate)
A0 : PH-4502C (Po) | A1 : Gravity TDS (A) | A2 : TS-300B (A)
5V : Breadboard Red (+) Rail (5.0V from LM2596S OUT+)
GND: Breadboard Blue (-) Rail (Common GND with LM2596S OUT-)
12V+ Jumper: LM2596S IN+ → Relay K1 COM & K2 COM
COMPLETE PIN-TO-PIN HARDWARE WIRING VERIFICATION TABLE (SMART AQUA POND)
1. Power System (12V Brick + LM2596S Buck) & Breadboard Bus
• 12V Power Brick (+) → LM2596S IN+ (Main 12V DC Input)
• LM2596S OUT+ (5.0V) → Breadboard Red (+) Rail (5.0V Logic/Sensors)
• LM2596S OUT- (GND) → Breadboard Blue (-) Rail (Common GND)
• Arduino 5V Pin → Breadboard Red (+) Rail (Shared 5.0V Rail)
• Arduino GND Pin → Breadboard Blue (-) Rail (CRITICAL Common GND)
* Jump Top (+) to Bottom (+) and Top (-) to Bottom (-) on Breadboard!
2. 4-Channel Relay Module & Actuators (Every NC Terminal Empty)
• Relay VCC → Breadboard Red (+5V) | Relay GND → Breadboard Blue (GND)
• K1 (Drain Pump) : IN1→D4 | COM→LM2596S IN+(12V) | NO→Drain RED(+)
• K2 (Refill Pump): IN2→D5 | COM→LM2596S IN+(12V) | NO→Refill RED(+)
• K4 (Servo Gate) : IN4→D10 | COM→Breadboard +(5V) | NO→Servo RED(+5V)
• All Pump/Aerator/Servo BLACK/BROWN (-) wires → Common GND Rail
• MG996R Servo YELLOW/ORANGE (Signal) → Arduino Digital Pin D9
3. All 5 Water & Depth Sensors + ESP32-CAM Vision
• DS18B20 Temp : + → Red(+5V) | - → Blue(GND) | S(DATA) → Pin D2
• JSN-SR04T Depth: 5V→ Red(+5V) | GND→Blue(GND) | TRIG→D7 | ECHO→D8
• PH-4502C pH : V+→ Red(+5V) | G →Blue(GND) | Po(Out) → Pin A0
• Gravity TDS : + → Red(+5V) | - →Blue(GND) | A(Sig) → Pin A1
• TS-300B Turbid.: V → Red(+5V) | G →Blue(GND) | A→Pin A2 (D Empty)
* Keep Arduino Pins D0 (RX) and D1 (TX) completely EMPTY for USB COM5!
